scripts.prisma:generate: npm run config:env && npm exec -w apps/api prisma -- generate --schema prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.prisma:migrate: npm run config:env && npm exec -w apps/api prisma -- migrate dev --name init --schema prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.prisma:push: npm run config:env && npm exec -w apps/api prisma -- db push --schema prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.prisma:studio: npm run config:env && npm exec -w apps/api prisma -- studio --schema prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.up: npm run config:env && docker compose -f ./infra/docker-compose.yml --env-file ./infra/.env up -d
